current.text: Curry has said publicly that his knee issue is a new normal.
Several experts are worried about his knee. It is the main reason they rank him below his per-game level.
He is the only Warriors player who really gets usage and creates his own shot. Santos is at most a minor second creator.
He is expected to carry a huge offensive load at age 38 because the roster lacks creators.
He is still one of the best players in the league at age 38.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year and are worried about their lottery odds.
The Warriors may rest veterans and may be bad enough to cut his minutes. One expert expects Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
He projects around 12th to 13th per game this season. His overall value range in category leagues is 20th to 30th, and taking him around pick 23 is fine.
Experts see his market ranks as a bit low for category leagues: Yahoo rank 25 is slightly low and ESPN rank 33 is too low for a top-12 per-game player.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He is much more valuable in category leagues than in points leagues.
He missed games late last season with runner's knee, a wear-and-tear issue.
Expect maintenance rest days because of the knee.
Injury is the main fantasy risk with Curry.
His three-point volume and free throw percentage are very consistent: 4.4 threes per game in each of the last two seasons and about 92 to 93 percent from the line.
His value comes from threes, points and FT%. His assists and steals are not particularly strong for a guard.
Turnovers are his weakest category, high for a guard.

note: Curry is an elite per-game category player. The newest expert call is 12th to 13th per game and 20th to 30th overall, held down by his knee, his age and the risk that a Warriors gap year cuts his minutes. Yahoo values him at 31 USD and ESPN at 22 USD, well below the 42 USD our league paid last season, so a bid up to about 30 USD fits the expert range. Do not pay a premium for him at 43 games played last season. He fits any build, best a threes and FT% team or a punt TO build. Early in the season, check his minutes, how often he rests on back-to-backs and whether the Warriors start resting veterans.
